title: Survival of a long random string among hard Poisson traps
summary: In [AJM26], we gave large-time asymptotic bounds on the annealed survival probability of a moving polymer taking values in ${\mathbb R}^d, d \geq 1$. This polymer is a solution of a stochastic heat equation driven by additive spacetime white noise on $[0,T] \times [0,J]$, in an environment of Poisson traps. For fixed $J$, the annealed survivial probability decays exponentially with rate proportional to $T^{d/(d+2)}$.
